final: WITH trader_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS trader_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY = r.trdref COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), total AS (SELECT SUM(trader_count) AS total_count FROM trader_counts), shares AS (SELECT trader_type, trader_count, CAST(trader_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share FROM trader_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS average_count FROM shares) SELECT trader_type, trader_count, share, trader_count - average_count FROM shares CROSS JOIN mean_count WHERE average_count IS NOT NULL AND trader_count > average_count
